ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, May 3, 2021 and to the campus on Monday, May 10, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m.The course will focus on the ever growing area of social media marketing. Topics of the course will range from omni-channel marketing, to digital maturity of firms, to social media plan development, to social media segmentation, targeting, and positioning. The course will be giving students a hands-on approach to social media marketing with social media analytics, content creation, and interactive discussion.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
